Help me pick a laptop under 80,000 rupees for programming
2:41 AM

For ₹80,000 look for 16 GB RAM, a 512 GB SSD, a recent Ryzen 5/7 or Core i5/Ultra 5 chip, a 1080p IPS screen and a keyboard you like typing on.

Skip a dedicated graphics card unless you do games or train AI AI. It adds cost and weight and cuts battery life.
Battery: aim for 8+ hours of real use if you code away from a desk.
Upgradeable RAM and SSD keep it useful for longer.
A Mac or a Windows laptop with Linux support both work, so it depends on your tools.

Which kind of programming do you mostly do: web and apps, data and AI, or games? Then I can look up current options and compare them.
